# p0_ai_gateway_staged (Resource)

A staged installation of an AI gateway.

P0 assigns a service account to communicate with your gateway, returned as `service_account_email`. Your
gateway must be configured to trust this service account (e.g. the `manageAllowedEmails` value in the
`ai-gateway-stack` Helm chart) before `p0_ai_gateway` can finish installing — P0 cannot
authenticate to your gateway's management API otherwise. See the example usage for the recommended pattern.

For instructions on using this resource, see the documentation for `p0_ai_gateway`.

For the full install steps, see [Gateway](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/resource-integrations/agentic-gateway/gateway).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# P0 assigns a service account to communicate with your gateway.
resource "p0_ai_gateway_staged" "example" {
  id = "primary"
  domain_hosting = {
    url = "https://gateway.example.com"
  }
}

# Your gateway must trust that service account before P0 can finish
# installing (see the p0_ai_gateway example for the next step).
# Uses the p0-security/p0-ai-gateway-stack/kubernetes module:
# https://github.com/p0-security/terraform-kubernetes-p0-ai-gateway-stack
module "ai_gateway_stack" {
  source  = "p0-security/p0-ai-gateway-stack/kubernetes"
  version = "1.3.0"

  chart_version = "1.3.0-beta"
  release_name  = p0_ai_gateway_staged.example.id
  namespace     = "p0-ai-gateway"

  values = [
    yamlencode({
      letsEncrypt = {
        env   = "prod"
        email = "admin@example.com"
      }
      postgresql   = { storageClass = "gp2" }
      victorialogs = { storageClass = "gp2" }
      valkey       = { storageClass = "<encrypted-storage-class>" }
      "ai-gateway" = {
        gateway = {
          className = p0_ai_gateway_staged.example.id
          host      = "gateway.example.com"
        }
        authServer = {
          oidcClientId = "your-upstream-oidc-client-id"
          gatewayIss   = "https://gateway.example.com"
        }
        accessProxy = {
          gatewayIss          = "https://gateway.example.com"
          manageAllowedEmails = p0_ai_gateway_staged.example.service_account_email
        }
      }
    }),
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_hosting` (Attributes) How this gateway's public hostname and DNS records are managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domain_hosting))
- `id` (String) A unique identifier for this gateway

### Read-Only

- `service_account_email` (String) Email address of the service account identity that P0 uses to communicate with your gateway

<a id="nestedatt--domain_hosting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domain_hosting`

Required:

- `url` (String) AI gateway URL; your servers will be hosted here.

Optional:

- `oauth_endpoint` (String) OAuth server endpoint; must be publicly accessible and host `.well-known/jwks.json`. Defaults to
`url` — only set this if your OAuth/JWKS endpoint runs on a different host than the gateway itself.
- `type` (String) Currently only 'selfHosted' (bring your own domain and manage its DNS records yourself) is supported.
